title: ProofPack · local software
caption: Turn a feature brief into browser checks and evidence you can share.
narration: ProofPack is local software for the last mile after building a feature. It turns a brief into browser checks, screenshots, traces, and a report you can inspect.

title: 01 · Describe the behavior
caption: Choose an allowlisted target. Describe the feature and expected outcomes.
narration: Start with an application you control, describe the feature, and state what success means. This sample checks whether a project survives logout and a fresh login.

title: 02 · AI plans; the browser executes
caption: Live mode: Groq / GPT-OSS 120B. We will inspect previously completed real runs.
narration: In live mode, the model plans goals and chooses bounded actions from page observations. This walkthrough inspects previously completed real Groq runs. It does not start new inference.

title: 03 · Working application: four checks pass
caption: Project creation → logout → fresh login → project still present. Actual recorded run.
narration: The working LaunchDesk run passed all four checks: project creation, logout, fresh login, and the project still being present. These results come from executable assertions.

title: 04 · Inspect the actions
caption: The timeline preserves actual browser steps, evidence references and attempt history.
narration: The timeline records what the browser actually exercised. It keeps actions and evidence references, including the fresh browser context used to test persistence across sessions.

title: 05 · See the passing evidence
caption: Captured by the actual browser run: the project remains after a fresh session.
narration: This is the screenshot cited by the final passing assertion. The project is visible after the fresh login. The evidence is stored locally and can be opened directly.

title: 06 · Broken application: persistence fails
caption: Three checks pass. The final persistence check fails. The report keeps that distinction.
narration: The deliberately broken application tells a different story. Creation and login work, but only three of four checks pass. The final persistence assertion detects the missing project.

title: 07 · Evidence of the failure
caption: The recorded project list is empty after login. The report does not invent a code-level cause.
narration: Creation looked successful, but the recorded project list is empty after login. ProofPack reports this observed failure. It does not pretend to know the underlying code-level cause.

title: 08 · Keep the history honest
caption: The earlier quota-blocked attempt stays visible. Fresh retries retain prior evidence.
narration: Earlier attempts stay visible. This run first encountered a provider quota block, then detected the feature failure on a fresh retry. The exhausted retry limit is explained.

title: 09 · Export a proof pack
caption: Download HTML with embedded screenshots, Markdown, and separate Playwright traces.
narration: The report brings the request and checks together. Export self-contained HTML with embedded screenshots, Markdown, or a separate sanitized Playwright trace for local investigation.

title: 10 · Share the evidence
caption: This is the exported HTML file opened independently of the dashboard.
narration: This exported HTML opens independently of the dashboard. Its screenshots are embedded in the file, so the recorded result can travel with its visual evidence.

title: 11 · Control evidence storage
caption: Retention is off here. Archival and optional expiry require a reviewed preview.
narration: Evidence storage makes the retention policy visible. It is off in this workspace. Reviewed archival keeps downloads available, while optional expiry preserves the historical assertion ledger.

title: 12 · Built to run on your machine
caption: Next.js dashboard → separate Playwright worker → SQLite ledger + local evidence files.
narration: The system uses a Next.js dashboard, a separate Playwright worker, and a SQLite ledger with local evidence files. Live hosted inference sends the brief and bounded page observations to the provider.

title: ProofPack · Show the proof
caption: AI selects actions. Executable checks determine outcomes. Keep the evidence.
narration: ProofPack helps developers demonstrate features, catch observable regressions, and share inspectable evidence. It covers the checks it actually ran. AI selects actions; executable assertions determine the outcome.
